links.outcome: Inter-grader agreement between two board-certified ophthalmologists on GPT-4o answer classification
links.effect: Inter-grader agreement kappa was 0.841 (P < 0.001) on a sample of encounters reviewed by a second ophthalmologist.

unlisted_practices: Using an LLM to audit EMR documentation for consistency with the final encounter diagnosis
Testing LLM performance on tabular EHR data with varying input subsets (chief complaint, HPI, eye exam)

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and data synthesis capability of GPT-4o on tabular EMR data from ophthalmology ED encounters, graded offline by ophthalmologists. It does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
